hook: Neeche paani mein floating tha Kabir ka helmet... aur tooti bike!
feedback: Great emotional twist with the double reveal (both brothers being dead). The pacing is effective, utilizing silent cuts well for atmospheric tension. To make Cut 1 even stronger, ensure the visual framing on Image I7 is an extreme close-up of the floating helmet to immediately grab the viewer's attention in the first 2 seconds. LENGTH: about 74s; it must be 40-52s (roughly 80-104 spoken words). REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Neeche paani mein floating tha Kabir ka helmet... aur tooti bike!
Jaigarh ki aakhri ferry par Kabir ke saath baitha insaan zinda nahi tha!
Par Kabir ko is baat ka andaaza tak nahi tha.
Raat 2:45 baje, Jaigarh Creek ki thandi dhund mein ferry tair rahi thi.
Teen saal puraane jhagde ke baad, Kabir apne bade bhai Samar ke liye modak lekar aaya tha.
Samar bagal mein baitha bas muskuraata raha... bina kuch bole.
Bhai, mujhe maaf kar do... maine bahut der kar di.
Samar ne Kabir ke kandhe par haath rakha... jo barf sa thanda tha.
Aur uske pair... deck ki lakdi ko chhoo bhi nahi rahe the!
Neeche paani mein floating tha Kabir ka helmet... aur tooti bike!
Kabir ki maut aadhe ghante pehle crash mein ho chuki thi.
Samar toh khud teen saal pehle mar chuka tha... aaj apne bhai ko raasta dikhane aaya tha.
Raat ko ferry par haath thaamne waale ka chehra zaroor dekhna... kahin wo tumhe paar karaane na aaya ho.
